question: Which one of the following is NOT a Fundamental Right under the Constitution of India?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भारतीय संविधान के तहत मौलिक अधिकार नहीं है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • 44th Constitutional Amendment (1978)
explanation: Right to Property was removed from Fundamental Rights by the 44th Amendment Act, 1978 and made a Legal Right under Article 300A.

question: Who signs the One Rupee (₹1) Currency Note in India?
question_hi: भारत में एक रुपये (₹1) के नोट पर किसके हस्ताक्षर होते हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • RBI Act, 1934
explanation: All currency notes except ₹1 are signed by the RBI Governor. The ₹1 note is issued by the Ministry of Finance and signed by the Finance Secretary.

question: The Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) does NOT pass through which of the following Indian states?
question_hi: कर्क रेखा (23.5° N) निम्नलिखित में से किस भारतीय राज्य से होकर नहीं गुजरती है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 9 Geography
explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram — NOT Manipur.

question: Who among the following does NOT participate in the Impeachment of the President of India?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत के राष्ट्रपति के महाभियोग में भाग नहीं लेता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 61, Constitution of India
explanation: State MLAs vote in the President's election, NOT in impeachment. Both elected and nominated members of Parliament participate in impeachment.

question: Which of the following metals was NOT known to the Indus Valley Civilization people?
question_hi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के लोगों को निम्नलिखित में से किस धातु का ज्ञान नहीं था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 12 History
explanation: Indus Valley was a Bronze Age civilization (copper, bronze, gold, silver were known). Iron came into use later during the Later Vedic period.

question: Which blood group is known as the Universal Recipient (can receive blood from any group)?
question_hi: किस रक्त समूह को 'सर्वग्राही' (Universal Recipient) कहा जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Biology
explanation: AB+ has both A & B antigens and Rh factor with no antibodies, making it the Universal Recipient. O- is the Universal Donor.

question: Who has the final authority to decide whether a Bill is a Money Bill or not in India?
question_hi: भारत में कोई विधेयक 'धन विधेयक' (Money Bill) है या नहीं, इसका अंतिम निर्णय कौन करता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 110(3), Constitution of India
explanation: Under Article 110(3), the Speaker of Lok Sabha has the final authority to certify a Money Bill, and it cannot be questioned in any court.

question: Which one of the following gases is NOT a Noble (Inert) Gas?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी गैस अक्रिय (Noble) गैस नहीं है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 10 Science
explanation: Group 18 Noble Gases are Helium, Neon, Argon, Krypton, Xenon, and Radon. Hydrogen (Group 1) is highly reactive, not an inert gas.

question: Which of the following freedoms is NOT guaranteed under Article 19(1) of the Constitution?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी स्वतंत्रता संविधान के अनुच्छेद 19(1) के अंतर्गत गारंटीकृत नहीं है?

options.text: Right to acquire and hold property
Right to reside anywhere in India

correct_answer: (c) Right to acquire and hold property
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • 44th Amendment Act (1978)
explanation: Article 19(1)(f) (Right to acquire, hold and dispose of property) was deleted by the 44th Amendment Act, 1978.

question: Which of the following is a Volatile Memory that loses its data when power is turned off?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वोलाटाइल मेमोरी है जिसका डेटा बिजली बंद होने पर मिट जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Tier-2 Official PYQ • NCERT Computer Science
explanation: RAM is volatile primary memory (temporary working memory), whereas ROM, EPROM, and SSD are non-volatile and retain data without power.

question: Who administers the Oath of Office to the Governor of an Indian State?
question_hi: भारत में किसी राज्य के राज्यपाल को पद की शपथ कौन दिलाता है?
highlight_phrase: Oath of Office to the Governor

options.text: Chief Justice of the State High Court

correct_answer: (c) Chief Justice of the State High Court
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 159, Constitution of India
explanation: The Governor is appointed by the President (Art. 155), but the Oath of Office is administered by the Chief Justice of the concerned State High Court (Art. 159).

question: Which of the following rivers does NOT flow into the Bay of Bengal?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी नदी बंगाल की खाड़ी में नहीं गिरती है?
highlight_phrase: NOT flow into the Bay of Bengal
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 9 Geography
explanation: Narmada and Tapi are major west-flowing peninsular rivers that flow through rift valleys into the Arabian Sea, not the Bay of Bengal.

question: Who among the following was the first Governor-General of Independent India?
question_hi: स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले गवर्नर-जनरल निम्नलिखित में से कौन थे?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Modern History
explanation: Lord Mountbatten was the first Governor-General of Independent India (1947–48). C. Rajagopalachari was the first INDIAN Governor-General.

question: Which of the following vitamins is NOT a Fat-Soluble Vitamin?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विटामिन वसा में घुलनशील (Fat-Soluble) नहीं है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 12 Biology
explanation: Vitamins A, D, E, and K are fat-soluble (memory trick: KEDA). Vitamins B-complex and C are water-soluble.

question: Which of the following is NOT a Constitutional Body in India?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत में एक संवैधानिक निकाय (Constitutional Body) नहीं है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Indian Polity (NCERT)
explanation: NITI Aayog is a non-constitutional, non-statutory executive body formed on 1 Jan 2015. Finance Commission (Art. 280), EC (Art. 324), and UPSC (Art. 315) are constitutional.

question: In which of the following mediums does Sound travel the FASTEST?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस माध्यम में ध्वनि (Sound) सबसे तेज़ गति से चलती है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 9 Science
explanation: Sound is a mechanical wave: it cannot travel in vacuum at all and travels fastest in solids (like Steel ~5960 m/s) > liquids > gases.

question: Who presides over a Joint Sitting of both Houses of the Indian Parliament?
question_hi: भारतीय संसद के दोनों सदनों की संयुक्त बैठक (Joint Sitting) की अध्यक्षता कौन करता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 108 & 118(4)
explanation: The President SUMMONS a joint sitting (Art. 108), but the Speaker of Lok Sabha PRESIDES over it (Art. 118(4)).

curiosity_tag: Battle of Plassey vs Buxar Trap!
question: In which year was the decisive Battle of Buxar fought in India?
question_hi: भारत में निर्णायक बक्सर का युद्ध (Battle of Buxar) किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History
explanation: Battle of Buxar was fought in 1764 (Hector Munro vs Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula & Shah Alam II). 1757 was Plassey; 1761 was 3rd Battle of Panipat.

question: The rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks is called?
question_hi: जिस दर पर RBI वाणिज्यिक बैंकों को अल्पकालिक ऋण देता है, उसे क्या कहते हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 12 Macroeconomics
explanation: Repo Rate = RBI lends to banks. Reverse Repo Rate = RBI borrows/absorbs liquidity from banks.

question: Which Indian state shares the LONGEST international border with Bangladesh?
question_hi: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य बांग्लादेश के साथ सबसे लंबी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा साझा करता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Ministry of Home Affairs / NCERT
explanation: West Bengal shares ~2,216 km with Bangladesh-the longest among all 5 Indian states bordering Bangladesh (WB, TR, ML, MZ, AS).

question: What is the chemical name of Baking Soda commonly used in cooking?
question_hi: खाना पकाने में उपयोग होने वाले 'बेकिंग सोडा' (Baking Soda) का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 10 Science
explanation: Baking Soda = Sodium Bicarbonate / Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate (NaHCO₃). Washing Soda = Sodium Carbonate (Na₂CO₃·10H₂O).

question: What is the minimum age required to become a member of the Rajya Sabha?
question_hi: राज्यसभा का सदस्य बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु कितनी होनी चाहिए?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 84, Constitution of India
explanation: Panchayat = 21 yrs | Lok Sabha / Vidhan Sabha = 25 yrs | Rajya Sabha / Vidhan Parishad = 30 yrs | President / Governor = 35 yrs.

question: Which protocol is used for sending emails across the Internet?
question_hi: इंटरनेट पर ईमेल भेजने (Send) के लिए किस प्रोटोकॉल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Tier-2 Official PYQ • NCERT Computer Networks
explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used to SEND emails; POP3 and IMAP are used to RECEIVE/retrieve emails.

question: Sattriya is a recognized classical dance form belonging to which Indian state?
question_hi: 'सत्त्रिया' (Sattriya) किस भारतीय राज्य का शास्त्रीय नृत्य है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Sangeet Natak Akademi
explanation: Sattriya was introduced in the 15th century by Mahapurusha Srimanta Sankardev in Assam and recognized as a classical dance in 2000.

curiosity_tag: Human Body Longest vs Largest Trap!
question: Which is the LARGEST gland in the human body?
question_hi: मानव शरीर की सबसे बड़ी ग्रंथि (Largest Gland) कौन सी है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Biology
explanation: Liver is the largest gland in the human body (~1.2–1.5 kg). Thyroid is the largest ENDOCRINE gland; Pituitary is the Master Gland.

question: The concept of 'Directive Principles of State Policy' (DPSP) was borrowed from which country?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान में 'राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्व' (DPSP) किस देश से लिए गए हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity
explanation: DPSP (Part IV, Art. 36–51) was borrowed from the Irish Constitution. Fundamental Rights came from the USA; Fundamental Duties from USSR.

question: In which session of the Indian National Congress did the famous 'Surat Split' happen?
question_hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में प्रसिद्ध 'सूरत विभाजन' (Surat Split) हुआ था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Modern History
explanation: Moderates and Extremists split in 1907 at the Surat Session (presided by Rash Behari Ghosh) and reunited in 1916 (Lucknow Pact).

question: Nathu La Pass connects Sikkim with which neighboring region/country?
question_hi: 'नाथू ला दर्रा' (Nathu La Pass) सिक्किम को किस पड़ोसी क्षेत्र/देश से जोड़ता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Geography
explanation: Nathu La and Jelep La are strategic mountain passes in Sikkim connecting India with China's Tibet Autonomous Region.

question: What is the SI Unit of Electrical Resistance?
question_hi: विद्युत प्रतिरोध (Electrical Resistance) की SI इकाई क्या है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 10 Science
explanation: Resistance = Ohm (Ω) | Current = Ampere (A) | Potential Difference = Volt (V) | Power = Watt (W).

question: How many Megabytes (MB) make 1 Gigabyte (GB) in standard binary memory?
question_hi: मानक बाइनरी मेमोरी में 1 गीगाबाइट (GB) में कितने मेगाबाइट (MB) होते हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Tier-2 Official PYQ • Computer Fundamentals
explanation: In binary computing, 1 KB = 1024 Bytes, 1 MB = 1024 KB, and 1 GB = 1024 MB (2¹⁰).

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with Financial Emergency?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद वित्तीय आपातकाल (Financial Emergency) से संबंधित है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Constitution of India
explanation: Art. 352 = National Emergency, Art. 356 = President's Rule, Art. 360 = Financial Emergency (never imposed in India so far).

question: Which Constitutional Amendment is known as the 'Mini Constitution' of India?
question_hi: किस संविधान संशोधन को भारत का 'मिनी संविधान' (Mini Constitution) कहा जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity
explanation: The 42nd Amendment Act (1976) added Socialist, Secular, Integrity to the Preamble and Fundamental Duties (Part IV-A).

question: To whom does the President of India submit his resignation letter?
question_hi: भारत के राष्ट्रपति अपना त्यागपत्र (Resignation) किसे सौंपते हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 56(1)(a)
explanation: The President submits his resignation to the Vice-President, who must immediately inform the Speaker of Lok Sabha.

question: Which Amendment reduced the voting age in India from 21 years to 18 years?
question_hi: किस संशोधन द्वारा भारत में मतदान की आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष कर दी गई?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • 61st Amendment Act (1988)
explanation: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act (1988, effective 1989) amended Article 326 to lower the voting age from 21 to 18.

question: Which Fundamental Rights can NEVER be suspended even during a National Emergency?
question_hi: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी कौन से मौलिक अधिकार कभी निलंबित नहीं किए जा सकते?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 359 (44th Amendment)
explanation: By the 44th Amendment (1978), Articles 20 (protection in conviction) and 21 (right to life) cannot be suspended during Emergency.

question: What is the retirement age of a Judge of the Supreme Court of India?
question_hi: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश की सेवानिवृत्ति आयु कितनी होती है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 124(2)
explanation: Supreme Court Judges retire at 65 years, while High Court Judges retire at 62 years.

question: The parliamentary device 'Zero Hour' in India was borrowed from which country?
question_hi: भारतीय संसद में 'शून्य काल' (Zero Hour) किस देश से लिया गया है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Indian Polity
explanation: Zero Hour (immediately after Question Hour at 12 noon) is an Indian parliamentary innovation in existence since 1962.

question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
question_hi: राज्यसभा का पदेन सभापति (Ex-officio Chairman) कौन होता है?
highlight_phrase: ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 64
explanation: Under Article 64, the Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes 'Untouchability'?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता' (Untouchability) का अंत करता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity
explanation: Article 17 abolishes Untouchability in any form. Article 18 abolishes Titles (except military and academic distinctions).

question: Under which Article does the President constitute the Finance Commission every 5 years?
question_hi: किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राष्ट्रपति प्रत्येक 5 वर्ष में वित्त आयोग (Finance Commission) का गठन करते हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Constitution of India
explanation: Article 280 provides for a Finance Commission as a quasi-judicial body to recommend tax distribution between Centre and States.

question: Which of the following words was NOT added to the Preamble by the 42nd Amendment (1976)?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द 42वें संशोधन (1976) द्वारा प्रस्तावना में नहीं जोड़ा गया था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity
explanation: 'Republic' was in the original Preamble of 1950. The 42nd Amendment (1976) added only Socialist, Secular, and Integrity.

question: Who is the highest law officer of the Government of India?
question_hi: भारत सरकार का सर्वोच्च विधि अधिकारी (Highest Law Officer) कौन होता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 76
explanation: Under Article 76, the Attorney General of India is the chief legal advisor and highest law officer of the Government of India.

question: How many official languages are currently listed in the 8th Schedule of the Constitution?
question_hi: संविधान की 8वीं अनुसूची में वर्तमान में कितनी आधिकारिक भाषाएं शामिल हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Constitution of India
explanation: Originally there were 14 languages in the 8th Schedule; today there are 22 (English is NOT in the 8th Schedule!).

question: Which Article guarantees Free and Compulsory Education to children aged 6 to 14 years?
question_hi: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 6 से 14 वर्ष के बच्चों को मुफ्त और अनिवार्य शिक्षा की गारंटी देता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • 86th Amendment Act (2002)
explanation: Article 21A was inserted by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 making elementary education a Fundamental Right.

question: What is the MAXIMUM permissible gap between two sessions of the Indian Parliament?
question_hi: भारतीय संसद के दो सत्रों के बीच अधिकतम अंतराल कितना हो सकता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Article 85(1)
explanation: Under Article 85(1), Parliament must meet at least twice a year with no more than a 6-month gap between two sessions.

question: Who led the Revolt of 1857 from Lucknow (Awadh)?
question_hi: लखनऊ (अवध) से 1857 के विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History
explanation: Begum Hazrat Mahal led at Lucknow; Nana Saheb at Kanpur; Kunwar Singh at Jagdishpur (Bihar); Rani Lakshmibai at Jhansi.

question: Where was the First Buddhist Council held immediately after Buddha's Mahaparinirvana?
question_hi: बुद्ध के महापरिनिर्वाण के तुरंत बाद प्रथम बौद्ध संगीति कहाँ आयोजित की गई थी?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Ancient History
explanation: 1st = Rajagriha (Ajatashatru) | 2nd = Vaishali (Kalasoka) | 3rd = Pataliputra (Ashoka) | 4th = Kashmir (Kanishka).

question: Who introduced the Permanent Settlement (Zamindari System) in Bengal in 1793?
question_hi: 1793 में बंगाल में स्थायी बंदोबस्त (Permanent Settlement) किसने लागू किया था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History
explanation: Lord Cornwallis introduced Permanent Settlement in 1793 in Bengal, Bihar, and Odisha. Lord Dalhousie introduced Doctrine of Lapse.

question: Who was the founder of the 'Brahmo Samaj' in 1828?
question_hi: 1828 में 'ब्रह्म समाज' (Brahmo Samaj) की स्थापना किसने की थी?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Modern History
explanation: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Brahmo Samaj (1828). Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded Arya Samaj (1875).

question: Which dynasty ruled Delhi IMMEDIATELY AFTER the Khilji Dynasty?
question_hi: खिलजी वंश के ठीक बाद दिल्ली पर किस वंश ने शासन किया?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 7 History
explanation: Delhi Sultanate order: Slave -> Khilji -> Tughlaq -> Sayyid -> Lodi (1206 to 1526).

question: Which Indus Valley Civilization site is famous for having the world's earliest tidal dockyard?
question_hi: कौन सा सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता स्थल अपने प्राचीन बंदरगाह (Dockyard) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 12 History
explanation: Lothal (in Gujarat, on Bhogava river) had a brick-built tidal dockyard. Kalibangan is famous for ploughed field evidence.

question: Who was the FIRST WOMAN President of the Indian National Congress?
question_hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की पहली महिला अध्यक्ष कौन थीं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Modern History
explanation: Annie Besant was the first woman INC President (Calcutta, 1917). Sarojini Naidu was the first INDIAN woman President (Kanpur, 1925).

question: In which year was the Kalinga War fought by Emperor Ashoka?
question_hi: सम्राट अशोक द्वारा कलिंग युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 6 History
explanation: Ashoka fought the Kalinga War in 261 BCE (8th year of his reign), described in his 13th Major Rock Edict.

question: Who was the Viceroy of India during the Partition of Bengal in 1905?
question_hi: 1905 में बंगाल विभाजन के समय भारत का वायसराय कौन था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History

question: Who built the famous Buland Darwaza at Fatehpur Sikri?

question: Which is the highest mountain peak located WHOLLY inside India?

question: The 'Ten Degree Channel' separates which two island groups?

question: Which of the following NON-METALS is liquid at room temperature?

question: A 'Light Year' is a unit used to measure which physical quantity?

options.text: High resistance and High melting point
Low resistance and High melting point
High resistance and Low melting point
Low resistance and Low melting point
